heading: WHY THIS EXISTS
paragraphs: Builders That Matter is an independent selection of early-stage startups across Europe, built around two purposes. First, to shine a light on the ambitious entrepreneurial talent this continent produces, still not loud enough. Second, a genuine belief that the most important technology isn't necessarily the most "convenient" - it's the kind rooted in hard science or intricate problems that advance the human condition.

I've always been drawn to complex problems and an avid reader of research papers across the most varied fields (e.g., from AI memory, sustainable textiles to organs-on-a-chip). Builders That Matter is my way to fuel that curiosity, connecting with driven, more scientific founders, especially those that build in traditional sectors.
